recommendation: Implement collaborative care model for depression management
implementation_steps: Provide systematic follow-up with regular patient contact
Implement measurement-based care with regular PHQ-9 assessments
Deliver patient education about depression and treatment options
Coordinate between primary care providers and psychiatric consultants
evidence_summary: Collaborative care models for depression have demonstrated significant improvements in symptom remission, treatment response, and adherence, with reduced time to remission (hazard ratio 2.48, median time 86 vs 614 days) and improved quality of life.
